ai.title: DeepSeek model added for diff retries in lite cost mode
ai.summary: The `retryDiffBlocksPrompt` function in `backend/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` now accepts a `costMode` parameter. When `costMode` is set to 'lite', the system uses `promptDeepseek` with the `models.deepseekChat` model instead of `promptClaude` with `models.sonnet`. The `processFileBlock` and `mainPrompt` functions were updated to propagate the `costMode` argument through the call chain. This change reduces costs for diff retry operations in lite mode by leveraging a cheaper model.

eli5.text: When the system needs to retry generating a code change and you're on the cheaper 'lite' cost plan, it now asks DeepSeek to help instead of Claude. This only affects users on that lower-cost plan who hit retry, the retry step will use the less expensive model from now on. If you're on a standard or higher plan, nothing changes.

ai.title: gpt4o fallback rewrite in pro mode
ai.summary: processFileBlock now threads costMode to applyRemainingChanges. Fallback rewrite model switches from gpt4omini to gpt4o when costMode === 'pro'. Internal backend logic; no user-facing config or model picker change.

eli5.text: When you're using the Pro tier and an automatic rewrite of your file needs to retry, it now picks the full GPT-4o model instead of the smaller, cheaper mini version. You won't see any new button or setting for this. If you looked at the request logs, you'd notice the fallback rewrite calls in Pro projects now go to GPT-4o rather than GPT-4o mini, matching the upgrade DeepSeek already made for diff retries last week.
